name: Permit.io
title: permit.io
shortDescription: Permit.io offers a comprehensive authorization service for both human and machine identities, enabling teams across an organization, from developers to sales, to manage permissions securely. It supports various models like RBAC, ABAC, and ReBAC and integrates seamlessly with existing architectures. Example use case: A tech company uses Permit.io to streamline access controls and improve security protocols without coding.
pros: Integrates with OPA's Rego and AWS' Cedar
API, Terraform provider, and SDKs available
